description: Land Acquisition - Mehiella, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose (Kurunegala-Habarana Railway Project). It contains cadastral map references, lot numbers, land descriptions, extents, and claimant information, which squarely fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land acquisition matters.
